payload.title: BatchFilterInput and UpdateBatchInput declare no class-validator decorators, so the global whitelist pipe rejects every non-empty batches(filter) call (BAD_REQUEST on every Feeding tab and the header KPIs) and every updateBatch

payload.notes: Part of the PLAT-HIGH-922 ratchet: the file leaves KNOWN_GAPS; the umbrella finding stays open for the remaining files.
